meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 为 agent 容器装上 mnemon 图记忆:Claude 每次回应前自动浮现相关历史记忆,每轮结束后写入新洞见。记忆存在按 agent 组的 .claude/ 目录,容器重启后仍保留。仅对默认 Claude provider 的分组生效。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude agent 跨会话记住上下文、给 agent 组添加持久记忆时使用;仅适用于 container.json 中 provider 缺省或为 claude 的分组。

say.text: 帮我给这个 agent 组装上 mnemon 持久记忆
检查一下 mnemon 的 hook 有没有注册成功
把这个 agent 的记忆全部清空
say.note: 需停容器并删宿主上的 mnemon/ 目录。

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon into the agent image: Claude recalls relevant past context before answering and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount and survives restarts. Claude provider only.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a Claude agent to remember context across sessions, or to add persistent memory to an agent group. Only applies to groups with provider "claude" (or none) in container.json.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory for this agent group
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds.

say_en.text: Check whether the mnemon hooks are registered
say_en.note: Looks at container logs and settings.json.

say_en.text: Reset all memory for this agent
say_en.note: Stops the container and deletes the mnemon/ dir.
